# National Institute of Justice

> > The National Institute of Justice (NIJ) is the research, development, and evaluation agency of the U.S. Department of Justice, advancing criminal justice through scientific research, forensic innovation, and evidence-based funding.

NIJ, the research arm of the Office of Justice Programs (OJP), funds and conducts research across six major portfolios including forensic science, law enforcement, crime prevention, and criminal justice systems. The agency provides grants, fellowships, datasets, and challenge competitions to advance evidence-based practices in criminal justice.

## Funding & Grants

- [Funding & Awards](https://nij.ojp.gov/funding): NIJ funding opportunities, grants, and research development programs
- [Current Funding Opportunities](https://nij.ojp.gov/funding/current): Current NIJ notices of funding opportunity and grant application guidance
- [Guidance for Applicants and Awardees](https://nij.ojp.gov/funding/guidance-applicants-and-awardees): Grant application guidance and requirements for NIJ funding applicants
- [Awards: Listing of Funded Projects](https://nij.ojp.gov/funding/awards/list): Searchable database of all NIJ-funded projects since 2003
- [NIJ's Fellowship and Student Programs](https://nij.ojp.gov/funding/fellowship-programs): NIJ graduate fellowships, research assistantships, and student programs
- [NIJ's Law Enforcement Advancing Data and Science (LEADS) Scholars Programs](https://nij.ojp.gov/funding/national-institute-justices-law-enforcement-advancing-data-and-science-leads-programs): LEADS Scholars program for law enforcement professional development
- [Using Challenges to Find Solutions](https://nij.ojp.gov/funding/using-challenges-find-solutions): NIJ challenge competitions and innovation prizes for criminal justice solutions

## About NIJ

- [Home](https://nij.ojp.gov): NIJ homepage: Criminal justice research, datasets, forensics, and funding opportunities
- [About the National Institute of Justice](https://nij.ojp.gov/about): Overview of NIJ mission, statutes, and organizational structure within DOJ
- [NIJ Research Portfolios](https://nij.ojp.gov/about/nij-research-portfolios): Overview of NIJ's six research areas and ongoing research portfolios
- [Research Validity and Integrity](https://nij.ojp.gov/about/research-validity-and-integrity): NIJ scientific integrity policy, peer review, and research ethics standards
- [NIJ's Intramural Research Initiative](https://nij.ojp.gov/about/intramural-research-initiative): Description of NIJ's internal science staff and intramural research programs
- [The NIJ Director](https://nij.ojp.gov/about/nij-director): Information about NIJ leadership and the director's role in research priorities

## Research & Publications

- [Articles Published by NIJ](https://nij.ojp.gov/library/articles/list): Directory of articles published by NIJ on forensics and criminal justice
- [How Science Is Advancing Criminal Justice](https://nij.ojp.gov/library/multimedia/podcasts): Justice Today Podcast: NIJ scientists discuss research advancing criminal justice

- [Assessments of NIJ](https://nij.ojp.gov/about/assessments-nij): NIJ audits, evaluations, and transparency reports from oversight agencies

- [Expired Funding Opportunities](https://nij.ojp.gov/funding/expired): Archive of expired NIJ funding opportunities and past grant programs
